# Lab 6.2: Ingestion-Time & Integer-Range Partitioning

## What We Are Going to Do
Create an ingestion-time partitioned table and an integer-range partitioned table, and inspect partitions with the PARTITIONS view.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Ingestion-time partitioning.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --table --time_partitioning_type=DAY lab06.raw_events event:STRING,amount:FLOAT64
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'INSERT INTO lab06.raw_events (event, amount) VALUES ("click", 1.0), ("buy", 49.0)'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Use the pseudo-columns.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT _PARTITIONTIME AS pt, _PARTITIONDATE AS pd, event, amount
FROM lab06.raw_events
WHERE _PARTITIONDATE = CURRENT_DATE();</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   You can also write into a specific day with the `$YYYYMMDD` decorator, for example `bq load lab06.raw_events$20260101 …`.

3. **[SQL] Integer-range partitioning.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab06.customers_by_id
PARTITION BY RANGE_BUCKET(customer_id, GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 100000, 10000))
AS
SELECT id AS customer_id, first_name, country
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab06.customers_by_id WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 20000 AND 29999;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Look at the partitions.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT table_name, partition_id, total_rows, total_logical_bytes
FROM lab06.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS
WHERE table_name IN ('customers_by_id', 'raw_events')
ORDER BY table_name, partition_id;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Integer partitions are named by their start value. Rows outside the range go to `__UNPARTITIONED__`.

5. **[Console] Check partition details.** Open `customers_by_id → Details`. See **Partitioned by: INTEGER RANGE** with start, end and interval.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Ingestion time | `_PARTITIONTIME` / `_PARTITIONDATE` pseudo-columns |
| Integer range | 10 buckets of 10,000 IDs |
| PARTITIONS view | Rows and bytes per partition |
| Limit | Up to 10,000 partitions per table |
